title: 8 Best AI Ad Reporting Tools for 2026: Top Platforms for Automated Insights & Creative Intelligence
summary: Compare ad reporting software for paid media, PPC and digital advertising. See platform coverage, reporting depth, pricing, free options and limitations
body_markdown:
The best ad reporting tools **combine advertising data across platforms, accounts and campaigns** without forcing teams to rebuild reports manually. We compared advertising reporting software for enterprise paid media, agencies, PPC, ecommerce and creative analysis based on platform coverage, reporting depth, source-of-truth data, delivery options, limitations and pricing.

## Best ad reporting tools by use case


- **Best for enterprise paid media and creative reporting:**[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/creative-reporting-tool) connects cross-channel performance, creative analysis and internal business metrics for high-spend teams.
- **Best for agency client reporting:** AgencyAnalytics provides automated reports, white-label dashboards and client portals priced by client.
- **Best PPC reporting tool:** Blueprint combines paid-media dashboards with attribution, forecasting and cross-channel budget analysis.
- **Best for spreadsheet or BI reporting:** Improvado standardizes advertising data for dashboards, warehouses and existing BI tools.
- **Best free ad reporting tool:** Triple Whale provides free ecommerce reporting with first-click and last-click attribution.
- **Best Facebook ad reporting tool:** Madgicx provides Meta-focused reporting with supporting Google Ads, TikTok and ecommerce data.


## 1.[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/creative-reporting-tool) : best enterprise ad reporting tool for paid media and creative analysis


[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/creative-reporting-tool) is the **lead recommendation for high-spend advertisers** that need reporting across platforms, accounts, markets and creative libraries. It combines campaign performance with the actual content inside each ad and can incorporate attribution, BI, warehouse, MMP and first-party business data.


- **Cross-platform reporting:** Starter supports Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn. Professional adds X, Reddit, Pinterest, Snapchat, Taboola, Microsoft, AppLovin and DV360.
- **Reporting depth:** Drill down from account and campaign reporting to ad sets, ads, creative assets, audiences, placements, markets and custom business segments.
- **Creative analysis:** Compare performance by hook, message, offer, CTA, format, creator, landing page and custom labels. The same creative can be deduplicated across campaigns and platforms.
- **Business outcomes:** Combine platform data with revenue, qualified leads, CAC, ROAS, LTV, retention and company-specific metrics.
- **Reporting automation:** Schedule reports for email or Slack and configure alerts for performance changes, anomalies and creative fatigue.
- **Enterprise controls:** Use role-based access and shared reports. Enterprise plans add SSO, admin roles and API support.
- **Reporting-to-action workflow:** Turn findings into briefs and new creative tests without rebuilding the supporting context in another system.


**Limitations:**[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/creative-reporting-tool) is designed for high-spend advertisers rather than small teams seeking a basic dashboard.


**Pricing:** Starter costs **$1,500 per month** for up to $100,000 in monthly ad spend and two ad accounts. Professional and Enterprise use custom pricing. All plans include unlimited team members.


## 2. AgencyAnalytics: best agency ad reporting software


AgencyAnalytics is built for agencies that need standardized, client-facing advertising reports. Its main strengths are **automated delivery, white-label presentation and multi-client management** .


- **Advertising integrations:** Connect Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, Amazon Ads, DV360 and other sources.
- **Client reporting:** Create branded dashboards, portals, document reports and slide decks.
- **Automation:** Schedule reports, add approval steps and configure goals, alerts and anomaly detection.
- **Agency management:** Maintain separate client workspaces and use roll-up reporting across accounts.


**Limitations:** AgencyAnalytics presents data from connected sources rather than providing independent conversion tracking. It **does not analyze the content inside ad creatives** , and per-client pricing can become material for large agencies.


**Pricing:** The core plan costs **$20 per client per month** when billed annually. A 14-day free trial and volume pricing are available.


## 3. Motion: best creative ad reporting tool for paid social


Motion **places images and videos beside their performance data** , making it easier for paid-social teams to compare creative concepts and individual ads. Its deepest reporting is available for Meta and TikTok.


- **Visual reporting:** Build reports that show creative assets alongside spend, conversions, CPA, ROAS and other performance metrics.
- **Creative aggregation:** Group ads by concept or asset across campaigns and accounts to compare combined results.
- **Creative analysis:** Review hooks, formats, messaging and other creative attributes through visual boards and breakdowns.
- **Reporting routines:** Save recurring reports, share views with stakeholders and deliver updates through Slack.


**Limitations:** Motion supports Meta, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn, giving it narrower coverage than general cross-channel tools. YouTube and LinkedIn have fewer analysis options. Each workspace can connect **one account per platform** , although plans support multiple workspaces.


**Pricing:** Starter costs **$750 per month** . Pro costs $1,200 per month and adds attribution integrations and view-only guests. Growth uses custom pricing.


## 4. RedTrack: best ad tracking and reporting software


RedTrack combines cross-channel ad reporting with **independently collected conversion and revenue data** . It is suited to advertisers that do not want to compare results produced under each platform's attribution rules.


- **Cross-channel reporting:** Combine performance from Meta, Google, TikTok, Snapchat, Microsoft, X, Pinterest and other paid-media sources.
- **Detailed drilldowns:** Analyze results by channel, campaign, ad group, ad, placement, device and customer journey.
- **Independent tracking:** Capture conversion and revenue events outside ad-platform reporting and send data back through conversion APIs.
- **Attribution reports:** Compare attribution views and connect spend with ecommerce or lead-generation outcomes.


**Limitations:** RedTrack requires **more tracking configuration than a dashboard-only tool** . Pricing can increase with events, tracked revenue, synchronization frequency and add-ons. Creative Analytics costs an additional $99 per month.


**Pricing:** **Relay is free** with limited UTM-based attribution. Paid plans start at $69 per month annually for affiliates and $83 per month annually for ecommerce brands.


## 5. DATALYR: best ad reporting platform for first-party revenue


DATALYR connects paid-media spend with purchases, subscriptions, renewals, qualified leads and other first-party outcomes. It is designed for teams that want campaign reporting based on **independently recorded revenue** .


- **Ad reporting:** Combine spend and performance from Meta, Google Ads and TikTok in one dashboard.
- **Campaign drilldowns:** Review results by channel, campaign, ad set, ad, conversion and customer.
- **Revenue reporting:** Connect advertising costs with purchases, recurring revenue, renewals and lead outcomes.
- **Journey analysis:** Inspect customer paths and compare platform-reported conversions with first-party records.


**Limitations:** Native ad-spend synchronization centers on **Meta, Google Ads and TikTok** . Reliable reporting depends on correct tracking, identity and revenue-source configuration. DATALYR does not provide content-level creative analysis or white-label client portals.


**Pricing:** Growth costs **$299 per month** , Scale costs $599 and Performance costs $1,199. Enterprise pricing is custom, and a free trial is available.


## 6. Superads: best cross-platform creative ad reporting tool


Superads combines **visual creative reporting with multi-account dashboards** for Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and Google Ads. Reports can be organized by platform structure, naming conventions or content-aware creative tags.


- **Cross-platform reporting:** Compare paid-media performance across supported social and search platforms.
- **Creative views:** Review ads in visual boards with spend, conversions, CPA, ROAS and other performance metrics.
- **Detailed breakdowns:** Filter by account, campaign, ad set, ad, creative type and detected creative attributes.
- **Interactive sharing:** Share boards by link and distribute updates through email, Slack or exports.


**Limitations:** Data normally synchronizes **every 24 hours** , custom metric formulas are unavailable and creative scores do not cover Google Ads. Its native source coverage is limited to four ad-platform families.


**Pricing:** Professional starts at **$125 per month** annually or $150 monthly for up to $100,000 in monthly ad spend. A 14-day trial is available.


## 7. Blueprint: best PPC reporting tool for budget allocation


Blueprint combines paid-media reporting with **attribution, forecasting and channel-budget recommendations** . It supports more than 50 integrations across search, social, retail media and other digital advertising sources.


- **Cross-channel dashboards:** Consolidate spend and performance across paid search, paid social and retail-media accounts.
- **Campaign drilldowns:** Analyze results by channel, campaign, ad set, ad, creative and audience.
- **Attribution:** Compare channel contribution and use first-party business data in reporting.
- **BI delivery:** Export normalized advertising data to dashboards and business-intelligence workflows.


**Limitations:** Detailed creative-content analysis and white-label client portals are not central capabilities. Advanced recommendations require the Pro plan, and standard subscriptions require a **12-month contract** .


**Pricing:** Starter begins at **$269 per month** . Pro begins at $1,948 per month, while Enterprise pricing is custom. A 14-day trial is advertised.


## 8. Triple Whale: best ecommerce ad reporting software


Triple Whale combines advertising spend with **orders, revenue, customers and product costs** . It is built primarily for Shopify and direct-to-consumer ecommerce reporting.


- **Cross-channel reporting:** Combine results from Meta, Google, TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, Microsoft, Amazon and other sources.
- **Revenue and profit:** Connect advertising costs with orders, products, margins and customer value.
- **Attribution:** Compare first-click, last-click and additional attribution models using Triple Pixel data.
- **Custom reporting:** Build dashboards and export results by email, Slack, CSV or Google Sheets.


**Limitations:** Triple Whale is a **weaker fit for B2B and service businesses** . Attribution depends on correct Triple Pixel and tracking setup. Scheduled reports, advanced measurement and warehouse synchronization require higher plans or add-ons.


**Pricing:** A **free plan** includes first-click and last-click attribution, 10 users and 12 months of retention. Paid plans are priced by annual GMV and selected capabilities.


## 9. Madgicx: best Facebook ad reporting tool for Meta-first teams


Madgicx provides **detailed Meta reporting** with supporting dashboards for Google Ads and TikTok. It can also incorporate GA4, Shopify and Klaviyo data into One-Click Report.


- **Cross-channel dashboards:** Combine Meta, Google Ads and TikTok data in shared reports.
- **Meta reporting:** Analyze accounts, campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives and audience segments in greater depth.
- **Custom reports:** Build dashboards for acquisition, ecommerce and creative performance.
- **Client delivery:** Share public dashboards, export PDF reports and schedule recurring delivery.


**Limitations:** Its deepest analysis applies to Meta. Google Ads and TikTok are reporting sources rather than managed channels. It **does not cover LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads, Pinterest, Snapchat or Amazon Ads** .


**Pricing:** Madgicx offers a 7-day trial. Public materials list paid plans from **$45 per month** , with final pricing based on Meta ad spend and selected products.


## 10. Improvado: best enterprise ad reporting platform for BI integration


Improvado collects, transforms and distributes advertising data across large enterprise technology stacks. It supports **more than 1,350 marketing and business sources** , including major search, social, retail-media and programmatic platforms.


- **Source coverage:** Connect paid search, paid social, retail media, programmatic platforms and internal business systems.
- **Data normalization:** Standardize campaign structures, metric definitions and naming across sources.
- **Enterprise reporting:** Build dashboards for business units, markets, channels, accounts and campaigns.
- **Data delivery:** Send prepared advertising data to warehouses, BI tools, spreadsheets and public reports.


**Limitations:** Full reporting plans require **custom pricing and a sales process** . Implementation can involve source mapping, transformation logic and warehouse configuration. Creative Analytics, MTA, MMM and incrementality testing are add-ons or higher-tier capabilities.


**Pricing:** **Limited free access** is available, but full Advanced and Enterprise reporting plans use custom pricing based on data volume, synchronization frequency, workspaces and selected modules.
